 BREAKING: LIVE: Homicide suspect dead after trooper-involved shooting near David City Lime offers free rides to polls ahead of Election Day 
 Omaha voters can use a code for two free 30-minute scooter or bike rides 
 The deal begins Saturday and runs through Election Day on Nov. 3. By First Alert 6 staff reports Published : Oct. 23, 2026 at 11:26 AM CDT | Updated : 3 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google OMAHA, Neb. (WOWT) - An electric vehicle company is offering free rides to Omaha voters ahead of Election Day.
 Lime says it is offering two free 30-minute rides on its scooters and bikes.
 The deal begins Saturday and runs through Election Day on Nov. 3.
 To participate, use the code “VOTE26” in the Lime app for free rides to and from a polling place.
